features: ⚠️ THIS VERSION DOES NOT TOUCH THE DATABASE. It does change where arrears end up in the journal: re-issuing an instalment plan shows the same totals as before, with the carry-over from previous years on a different account.

ARREARS THAT PASSED FOR THIS YEAR'S BUDGET — When an instalment plan absorbs opening balances through an Instalment 0, that money is not an expense approved for the current year: it is a carry-over from previous financial years. Issuing recorded it together with the budget, on the same «Instalment Income» account. With € 1,800.00 of arrears and € 1,600.00 of budget, the year appeared to have called in € 3,400.00, and the year's approved amount could no longer be told apart from the carry-over. Now the approved part closes on «Instalment Income» and the carry-over on the «Previous Years Fund» — the same account used to bring in a cash account's opening balance, and for the same reason.

LOADING ARREARS OWED TO SUPPLIERS SAVED NOTHING, AND SAID NOTHING — In the supplier's page, «load past debt» refused every amount: the field writes «380,00» with a comma, the check demanded a plain number, and the dialog had nowhere to show the error. You pressed the button and nothing happened. The damage went further: that same page states that past-year invoices cannot be recorded unless the debt was declared first — so the whole past-invoice path was unreachable. The amount is now read correctly in all its forms, and every rejection has a message on the field.

PREPAID CONTRIBUTIONS COUNTED TWICE — Declaring that money collected earlier is «still sitting in the bank» made the program credit it to the cash account. But anyone who opens the cash account with the bank statement balance — the correct order of work — already had that money in there, and saw it counted a second time: in the test case the account showed € 5,000.00 against € 3,000.00 of real bank balance. Neither order of work is wrong, and the program cannot guess which one you followed: a third answer was therefore added — «still there, and already in the opening balance» — which records the earmark without crediting anything.

THE BADGE THAT CRIED WOLF — An instalment plan using prepaid contributions asks owners only for the remainder, so it is worth less than its chapters' budget: the program flagged it as «misaligned» and invited a recalculation, which is exactly what not to do to a correct plan. The comparison now accounts for what has already been paid in.

SMALL THINGS YOU COULD SEE — The IBAN is no longer required to open a bank account: it is there to fill in transfers, not to keep the books, and someone taking over a building often does not have it on day one. The supplier's VAT number now actually appears on the invoice and payment screens (the program read a field that did not exist, and showed «no VAT number» for everyone). The plan approval dialog shows its labels instead of internal technical names. The error about a tax code already in use now clears when you correct it. And in the collection dropdowns «Sorry, no matching options» is now in Italian.
